KeysToEntries.ID_ITEMDESC_AUGMENT_COMBAT_FREELOADOUT: The Free Loadout version of the Combat augment. Focuses on combat ability, with standard carry capacity and utility.
KeysToEntries.ID_ITEMDESC_AUGMENT_COMBAT_T2: A combat augment more focused on maneuverability than absorbing damage.
KeysToEntries.ID_ITEMDESC_AUGMENT_COMBAT_T1: Basic combat augment. Supports stronger shields, but with limited backpack capacity and Quick Use slots.
KeysToEntries.ID_ITEMDESC_AUGMENT_COMBAT_T3_AGGRESSIVE: An improved version of the Combat II augment. Supports more shield types, and comes with extra space for grenades.
KeysToEntries.ID_ITEMDESC_AUGMENT_COMBAT_T3_FLANKING: A combat augment more focused on maneuverability than absorbing damage.
KeysToEntries.ID_ITEMDESC_AUGMENT_UTILITY_FREELOADOUT: The Free Loadout version of the Tactical augment. Adds more Quick Use slots for increased tactical opportunities.
KeysToEntries.ID_ITEMDESC_AUGMENT_UTILITY_T1: Basic tactical augment. More Quick Use slots for more tactical choice, but limited survivability and slightly lower looting potential.
KeysToEntries.ID_ITEMDESC_AUGMENT_UTILITY_T2: Adds more backpack space and an extra utility item slot.
KeysToEntries.ID_ITEMDESC_AUGMENT_UTILITY_T3_DEFENSIVE: A defense-focused augment for keeping Shields topped up.
KeysToEntries.ID_ITEMDESC_AUGMENT_UTILITY_T3_HEALING: A healing-focused augment which adds extra slots for healing items.
KeysToEntries.ID_ITEMDESC_AUGMENT_LOOTING_FREELOADOUT: The Free Loadout version of the Looting augment. Most carry capacity, but with least defensive and tactical capability.
KeysToEntries.ID_ITEMDESC_AUGMENT_LOOTING_T1: Basic looting augment. More backpack slots and weight capacity, but low defensive and tactical capability.
KeysToEntries.ID_ITEMDESC_AUGMENT_LOOTING_T2: Significantly increases looting potential; adds slots for trinkets.
KeysToEntries.ID_ITEMDESC_AUGMENT_LOOTING_T3_CAUTIOUS: A looting augment that swaps some carry capacity to increase survivability.
KeysToEntries.ID_ITEMDESC_AUGMENT_LOOTING_T3_DBNO: A heavy-duty pack mule augment. Large weight capacity and large backpack space.
KeysToEntries.ID_ITEMDESC_AUGMENT_FREELOADOUT: Basic augment for rookie Raiders, offering slightly more backpack space and carry capacity.
KeysToEntries.ID_ITEMDESC_AUGMENT_DURABILITY: Augments will break once durability reaches zero.
KeysToEntries.ID_ITEMDESC_AUGMENT_COMBAT_T3_RELOADER: A combat augment prioritising offensive capability and preparedness at the expense of backpack space.
KeysToEntries.ID_ITEMDESC_AUGMENT_LOOTING_T3_CUSTODIAN: A looting augment that trades weight and utility for increased looting potential.
KeysToEntries.ID_ITEMDESC_AUGMENT_UTILITY_T3_REVIVAL: A tactical augment focused on utility over defense and looting.
KeysToEntries.ID_ITEMDESC_AUGMENT_T4_CUSTODIAN: An augment that trades weight and utility for increased looting potential.
KeysToEntries.ID_ITEMDESC_AUGMENT_T4_REVIVAL: An augment focused on utility over defense and looting.
KeysToEntries.ID_ITEMDESC_AUGMENT_UTILITY_T3_SMOKE: An upgraded version of the Tactical MK. 2 augment, adding expanded capacity across the board.
